intent: Freeze entry-time protective stops BEFORE historical backtesting; compare to original MR40 and arm2_be, preserving all natural exits.
rule: An entry-time stop is derived from the actual buy fill, active at the buy candle's OPEN immediately AFTER the entry fill. If the first 4h candle LOW <= stop, execute stop less slip; later candles gap through stop execute at OPEN less slip, otherwise at stop less slip. If natural MR40 sell is scheduled at a later OPEN, sell first; no retroactive stop. If arm2 is enabled, use prior fully closed 4h candle CLOSE >= actual entry fill*1.02 to raise stop to actual buy fill from the NEXT OPEN onward. Never lower stop. Upon stop exit, block same signal episode re-entry. No high-trigger, no leverage, same frozen Bybit/LBank inputs.
locked_selection: Profit gate training normal PNL >= baseline; stress PNL >= 1.05*baseline; worst DD <=1.1*baseline. Efficiency training normal CAGR >=.75*base, stress CAGR>0, worst DD <=.9*base and stress CAGR/worst DD >=1.1*base. Evaluation must have normal and stress PNL each >=.75*base and worst DD <=.8*base and stress CAGR/worst DD>=1.1*base. Evaluate all candidates and report no promotion if none meets held-window thresholds. Previously observed prices mean no true blind future validation.
